name: Rebuild Cilium kernel with XFRM
command: cd /home/ganshun/k4s && export PATH=/tmp/dwarves-root/usr/bin:$PATH && make -C linux O=$PWD/build/kernel-cni tinyconfig >/dev/null && cat configs/k4s-tiny.config configs/k4s-cni.config >> build/kernel-cni/.config && make -C linux O=$PWD/build/kernel-cni olddefconfig >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -E '^CONFIG_(XFRM|XFRM_USER)=' build/kernel-cni/.config && make -C linux O=$PWD/build/kernel-cni -j$(nproc) bzImage 2>&1 | tail -3 && ls -l build/kernel-cni/arch/x86/boot/bzImage
